data.name: slice
data.detailed_description:
A small life simulator with lofi graphics, built for moddability and extensive replayability. The simulation is meant to be complex in depth but easy to grasp and fully multiplayer.

FEATURES

-Life simulation with a focus on depth and customization

-Tend to your personas needs with a 7 axis simulation

-Build mode with a focus on ease of usage and powerful build and placement tools

-Single player and Online Coop both supported

PLANNED ADDITIONS

-Rich simulation of various life aspects, including in-depth jobs and hobbies

-A powerful but simple character creator that prioritizes customization and interesting designs

-Various life stages, grow with your personas

-Pets and other furry friends

-Neighbourhoods with multiple lots and places of interest

MODDING AND CONTENT

-Modding capabilites via an integrated and sandboxed Lua API where modders are first class

-Ease of map design via a simple .lot file (serialized JSON)

MULTIPLAYER FOCUSED

-Join a hosts world or neighbourhood and live in the same town.

-Live on the same lot as roommates

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: win 10/11
  • Processor: 2.5 GhZ processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1070 or equivalent
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: any
  • VR Support: none
